blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.
blocks.zh: 罕见的遗传障碍因其多样性和重叠的临床特征而难以诊断. 面部形态学可以提供诊断线索,然而大多数诊断模型提供的可解释性有限,并非旨在支持对未诊断疾病的广泛筛查. 我们介绍ProtoGestalt, 一种可解释的原型框架, 用于面部麻黄,罕见病的筛查, 和综合症的识别。 该方法通过限制学习到的视觉特征来扩展原型学习,以选择面部区域,通过局部性和添加性的证据来解释预测. 我们评估ProtoGestalt在多个控制数据集和类流行值上区分合成与未受影响的面孔的能力. 我们进一步评价它在训练时观察到的 综合症的诊断性能 所学的原型表示法为合成图像和大小写匹配的控制图像提供了显著的分离,并随着控制比例的增加而保留了有用的性能. 该框架还显示出区分综合症的能力。 尽管已经存在合理准确的罕见病面部分类专业模型,但ProtoGestalt提供了一种可解释的替代方法,将预测与解剖有意义的面部区域联系起来,有可能支持临床决策,发现苯基基因关联.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rare genetic disorders affect more than 6% of the global population. There are an estimated 7,000–10,000 known rare diseases, approximately 80% of which have a genetic etiology ( Marwaha et al. 2022 ) , while fewer than 10% have an approved therapy ( Halley et al. 2022 ) . Due to the large number of disorders, extensive phenotypic heterogeneity, and overlapping clinical presentations, the median time to diagnosis is 4-7 years ( Heuyer et al. 2017 ; Molster et al. 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 极少的遗传病影响到全球人口的6%以上。 估计有7,000–10,000种已知的罕见疾病,其中约80%有遗传病原学(Marwaha等人,2022年),而只有不到10%的人有经批准的疗法(Halley等人,2022年)。 由于大量紊乱,广泛的间皮异质性,以及临床演示重叠,诊断时间的中位数为4-7年(Heyer等人,2017年;Molster等人,2016年).

blocks.en: A necessary step toward a rare disease diagnosis is referral for genetic testing by a front-line clinician. This referral, however, is usually substantially delayed relative to symptom onset because clinicians do not consider rare diseases in their initial assessments. This is partly because two-thirds of clinicians significantly underestimate the prevalence of rare diseases, considering them to be 50 to 500 times rarer than the standard definitions used in the U.S. and Europe ( Rohani-Montez et al. 2023 ) . Additionally, rare diseases exhibit complex, variable phenotypic presentations that may overlap with those of more common conditions, further delaying evaluation. Indeed, prior studies indicate that many clinicians may not recognize rare disease phenotypes and report a lack of knowledge of rare disease symptoms as a barrier to diagnosis ( Rohani-Montez et al. 2023 ; Budych et al. 2012 ) . Even after rare conditions are considered, the existence of thousands of phenotypically complex rare conditions, many with overlapping features, presents a significant challenge to determining a specific diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 向罕见疾病诊断迈出的必要一步是,由一线临床医生转诊进行遗传检测。 然而,就症状发作而言,这种转诊通常被大大推迟,因为临床医生在其初步评估中并不考虑罕见的疾病。 部分原因是三分之二的临床医生严重低估了罕见疾病的流行,认为它们比美国和欧洲使用的标准定义(Rohani-Montez等人,2023年)少50到500倍. 此外,罕见的疾病呈现出复杂、多变的外表,可能与较常见的疾病重叠,进一步拖延评价。 事实上,先前的研究表明,许多临床医生可能不承认罕见的病原型,并报告说缺乏对罕见病症状的了解是诊断的障碍(Rohani-Montez等人,2023年;Budych等人,2012年)。 即使在考虑了罕见的病症后,还存在数千种多发性复杂的罕见病症,其中许多病症具有重叠的特征,对确定具体诊断提出了重大挑战.

blocks.en: Computational methods could assist with early recognition of individuals with undiagnosed rare disease (i.e., those for whom rare disease has yet to be considered in diagnostic planning) and subsequent disease specific diagnosis. Surprisingly, there has been only limited work on identifying patients with undiagnosed rare diseases, with most existing studies focusing on screening for a single disease. For example, Bhasuran et al. developed a machine learning pipeline to identify patients with acute hepatic porphyria ( Bhasuran et al. 2025 ) . While potentially useful, this approach would require a separate model for each rare disease, making this paradigm impractical as a general screening strategy. In contrast, the ThinkRare model uses a rule-based approach applied to structured EHR data to identify pediatric patients with any undiagnosed multisystem rare genetic disease who are eligible for exome sequencing ( Ediae et al. 2025 ) . However, the rule-based design encodes fixed expert-defined clinical eligibility criteria, limiting adaptability across institutions with different documentation conventions or patient populations.
blocks.zh: 计算方法可以帮助早期识别未确诊的罕见病(即那些在诊断规划中尚未考虑罕见病的人)以及随后的疾病特定诊断. 令人惊讶的是,鉴定未确诊的罕见疾病的患者的工作有限,现有研究大多侧重于单一疾病的筛查. 例如,Bhasuran et al. 开发了一台机器学习管道,以识别急性肝炎患者(Bhasuran等人,2025年)。 这种方法虽然可能有用,但需要对每种罕见疾病采取单独的模式,使这一范式作为一般筛选战略不切实际。 与此相对照,ThinkRare模型采用了一种基于规则的方法,应用于结构化的EHR数据,以识别患有任何未诊断的多系统罕见遗传疾病的儿科患者,这些患者有资格进行体外测序(Ediae等人,2025年). 然而,基于规则的设计编码了固定的专家定义的临床资格标准,限制了不同文献惯例的机构或病人群体的适应性。

blocks.en: Many algorithmic models, including Xrare ( Li et al. 2019 ) , LIRICAL ( Robinson et al. 2020 ) , PhenoBrain ( Mao et al. 2025 ) , and SHEPHERD ( Alsentzer et al. 2025 ) , have been developed to infer a patient’s specific rare disease diagnosis. These methods rely on detailed phenotypic information about the patient, typically using a controlled vocabulary such as the Human Phenotype Ontology ( Köhler et al. 2021 ) , and, optionally, genetic sequence data. This phenotype labeling requirement poses a substantial challenge as ontologies such as the HPO are complex. Indeed, the current HPO version (v2026-06-23) contains over 20,000 terms. Additionally, it includes many subjective terms that are difficult for non-experts to apply in practice. For example, the term midline nasal groove is described as “an abnormal groove on the midline of the nose that may extend to the nasal tip.” Finally, none of these systems have been adapted to the problem of identifying individuals with an undiagnosed rare disease.
blocks.zh: 开发了许多算法模型,包括Xrare(Li等人,2019年),LIRICAL(Robinson等人,2020年),PhenoBrain(Mao等人,2025年),SHEPHERD(Alsentzer等人,2025年)等,以推断患者的具体罕见疾病诊断. 这些方法依赖于关于患者的详细的间皮信息,一般使用控制词汇如人类间皮类肿瘤(Köhler等人,2021年),以及选择性的遗传序列数据. 由于HPO等本体学是复杂的,因此这种酚类标签要求带来了巨大的挑战. 事实上,目前的HPO版本(v2026-06-23)包含超过20,000个词汇. 此外,它还包括许多非专家在实践中难以应用的主观术语。 例如,中线鼻沟被描述为“鼻子中线上的异常鼻沟,可能延伸到鼻尖。” 最后,这些系统都没有适应确定患有未经诊断的罕见疾病的个人的问题。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, DeepGestalt ( Gurovich et al. 2019 ) and GestaltMatcher ( Hsieh et al. 2022 ) use deep learning methods on facial images for rare disease diagnosis. The facial gestalt, or overall facial morphology, is often a characteristic clinical feature indicating presence of an undiagnosed rare disease, with certain features associated with specific diagnoses ( Kirchhoff et al. 2025 ) . Approximately 30–40% of genetic disorders include facial dysmorphology features ( Ferry et al. 2014 ) . Both DeepGestalt and GestaltMatcher are end-to-end models and neither provides a mechanism for ascribing specific, clinically interpretable phenotypic features to individual patients or diseases. As with the aforementioned rare disease diagnostic models, these models have not been adapted to support undiagnosed rare disease screening.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,DeepGestalt(Gurovich等人,2019年)和GestaltMatcher(Hsieh等人,2022年)在面部图像上采用了深层学习方法,用于罕见疾病诊断. 面部腺体,或称整体面部形态,往往是一个典型的临床特征,表明存在未经诊断的罕见疾病,某些特征与具体诊断有关(Kirchhoff等人,2025年). 大约30-40%的遗传疾病包括面部畸形特征(Ferry等人,2014年)。 深盖塔尔特和盖塔尔特 配对者是端到端的模型,既不提供将具体,临床可解释的麻黄特征描述给个别患者或疾病的机制. 与上述罕见疾病诊断模型一样,这些模型还没有被调整,以支持未经诊断的罕见疾病筛查.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce ProtoGestalt , a prototype learning model to support both identification of individuals with undiagnosed rare diseases and disease diagnosis for individuals suspected of having a rare disease. ProtoGestalt is an extension of PIP-Net ( Nauta et al. 2023b ) which learns latent-space prototypes that represent characteristic portions of objects, in our case facial regions. We extend this approach by enforcing anatomical constraints on the prototype learning process using facial landmarks. The primary advantage of our approach is that the model predictions are inherently explainable through visualization of the matching prototypes for a given input. Additionally, prototypes that are consistently present across individuals with the same condition can potentially be used to objectively characterize the disease, which may help support rare disease research. We make the following contributions: (1) develop ProtoGestalt , an anatomy constrained extension of the PIP-Net model that learns prototypic facial dysmorphology characteristics associated with rare disease and performs disease diagnosis for common rare disorders; (2) present the novel task of determining if an individual has an undiagnosed rare disease or is unaffected by a rare disease based on prototypical representations for a given input facial image ; (3) extend ProtoGestalt to infer if an input image is of an individual affected or not affected by a rare disease.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了ProtoGestalt,一种原型学习模式,既支持识别未诊断出罕见疾病的个人,也支持诊断出怀疑患有罕见疾病的个人。 ProtoGestalt是PIP-Net(Nauta等人,2023年b)的延伸,它学习了潜在空间原型,这些原型代表了物体的特征部分,就我们而言,是面部区域。 我们通过使用面部标志来强化对原型学习过程的解剖限制来扩展这一方法. 我们的方法的主要优点是,模型预测通过可视化特定输入的匹配原型来内在解释. 此外,在病情相同的个人中始终存在的原型可能被用来客观地描述这种疾病,这可能有助于支持罕见疾病研究。 我们做出以下贡献:(1) 开发ProtoGestalt,即PIP-Net模型的解剖学限制延伸,该模型学习与稀有疾病相关的原始面部畸形特征,并对常见稀有疾病进行疾病诊断;(2) 提出新任务,确定一个人是否有未诊断的稀有疾病,或根据特定输入面部图像的原始表现而不受稀有疾病影响;(3) 扩展ProtoGestalt,以推断输入图像是否受稀有疾病影响或未受影响。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Rare Disease Diagnosis via Facial Images
blocks.zh: 通过面部图像进行罕见疾病诊断

blocks.en:
Automated facial analysis systems have demonstrated strong performance for rare disease diagnosis. DeepGestalt is a
convolutional neural network trained on over 17,000 patient images spanning 216 syndromes. It achieved 91% top-10 accuracy in syndrome identification. This approach was extended with GestaltMatcher , which encodes facial images into a 320-dimensional Clinical Face Phenotype Space and enables patient-to-patient matching, supporting recognition of ultra-rare syndromes not represented in the training set. It was later improved with updated CNN backbone models, model ensembles, and test time augmentation, ultimately achieving top-1 and top-5 disease diagnostic performances of 49% and 72%, respectively, across 204 disorders ( Hustinx et al. 2022 ) . The internal representations learned by these models are not interpretable, limiting their utility for objective phenotype characterization independent of a diagnostic label.
blocks.zh:
自动面部分析系统已经显示出罕见疾病诊断的有力性能. 深剑是一个
进化神经网络 训练超过17,000个病人图像 跨越216种综合征。 它在综合征识别中实现了91%的上-10精度. 这种方法与GestaltMatcher(英语:GestaltMatcher)被扩展,将面部图像编码成一个320维临床面孔型空间,并使病人与病人之间能够匹配,支持识别在训练集中没有表现的超射线综合征. 后经CNN更新骨干模型,模型综艺,测试时间增强等改进,最终在204种疾病中分别实现49%和72%的顶级-1和顶级-5疾病诊断性能(Hustinx等人,2022年). 这些模型所学出的内在表现是无法解释的,限制了它们对于独立于诊断标签的客观的苯基特征的用途.

blocks.en: Synthetic Rare Disease Facial Image Generation
blocks.zh: 合成稀有疾病面部图像生成

blocks.en: To address data scarcity and privacy constraints that impede training AI systems, some studies have explored generative AI to produce synthetic facial images with disorder-specific dysmorphology. Kirchhoff et al. used a conditional StyleGAN architecture to generate portraits for 20 disorders ( Kirchhoff et al. 2025 ) . Benichou et al. applied diffusion models with syndrome-specific model fine-tuning to produce ethnically balanced synthetic faces for 10 syndromes, demonstrating improved classifier performance when synthetic images supplemented real training data ( Benichou et al. 2025 ) . However, both approaches generate whole-face images intended to augment training data for diagnostic models and do not produce structured, reusable phenotypic descriptors.
blocks.zh: 为了解决阻碍训练AI系统的数据稀缺和隐私限制,一些研究探索了基因AI,以生成具有障碍特异性的面部图像. Kirchhoff等人使用有条件的StyleGAN架构生成20种紊乱的肖像(Kirchhoff等人,2025年). Benichou等人应用了具有综合症特异性模型微调的传播模型,为10种综合症产生种族平衡的合成面,在合成图像补充实际培训数据时,显示出分类器性能的改善(Benichou等人,2025年)。 然而,这两种方法都生成全面图像,旨在增加诊断模型的培训数据,而不产生结构化、可重复使用的线性描述。

blocks.en: Prototypical Networks
blocks.zh: 原型网络

blocks.en: Prototype-based interpretable networks are designed to explain predictions by comparing image regions with learned representative patches. For instance, ProtoPNet ( Chen et al. 2019 ) classifies images by comparing parts of the input to learned "prototypes" (e.g., specific features like a bird’s beak), to provide understandable class-based explanations. PIP-Net ( Nauta et al. 2023b ) improved prototype organization and interpretability by learning sparse, human-aligned prototypes through self-supervision and a non-negative classifier. These models have also been explored in explaining medical imaging tasks ( Yazdani et al. 2025 ) , ( Wei et al. 2024 ) , ( Nauta et al. 2023a ) . However, prototype-based networks have not been applied to rare-disease facial phenotyping, and existing methods do not enforce anatomically consistent prototype locations.
blocks.zh: 基于原型的可解释网络通过将图像区域与学到的代表性补丁进行比较来解释预测. 例如,ProtoPNet(Chen等人,2019年)通过比较部分输入到学习到的"原型"(如鸟喙等具体特征)来分类图像,以提供可以理解的基于阶级的解释. PIP-Net (Nauta等人). 2023b)通过自导自演和无阴性分类来学习稀疏,与人相适应的原型,从而改进了原型组织和解释性. 在解释医疗成像任务时也探索了这些模型(Yazdani等人,2025年),(Wei等人,2024年),(Nauta等人,2023a年). 然而,基于原型的网络还没有被应用于罕见的疾病面部麻痹,现有的方法并没有强制进行解剖一致的原型位置.

blocks.en: Data
blocks.zh: 数据

blocks.en: Facial images of rare disorders
blocks.zh: 罕见障碍的面部图像

blocks.en: We used the GestaltMatcher Database (GMDB) ( Hsieh et al. 2022 ) version 1.1.0 for model training and evaluation. GMDB contains 10,980 frontal images of 8,346 unique patients with 581 different syndromes. We followed the data splitting strategy proposed in ( Hustinx et al. 2022 ) and split the data across syndromes into two sets: GMDB-Frequent (syndromes with more than six patients) and GMDB-Rare (syndromes with six or fewer patients). There are 9,671 images of 7,294 patients with 275 syndromes in GMDB-Frequent. GMDB-Rare contains 1,309 images of 1,052 patients with 306 syndromes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GestaltMatcher数据库(GMDB)(Hsieh等人,2022年)1.1.0版本用于模式培训和评价. GMDB包含10,980张正面图像,显示有881种不同综合征的8,346位独特的患者. 我们遵循了(Hustinx等人,2022年)提出的数据分割战略,将跨综合征的数据分成两套:GMDB-Frequent(超过6名患者的合成)和GMDB-Rare(6名或更少的患者的合成). GMDB-Frequent经常出现7,294位275种综合征患者的9,671张影像. GMDB-Rare包含有1,309幅306种综合征患者的1,052幅图像.

blocks.en: We further split GMDB-Frequent into training, validation and test sets and used it to train, fine-tune and evaluate ProtoGestalt . We used GMDB-Rare only for evaluation as it provides a syndrome-disjoint test set for assessing whether the learned prototypes generalize to facial images from syndromes that were not observed during training. This evaluation setting reflects clinical diagnosis of ultra rare conditions, where the underlying disorder may not be represented in training data. An overview of the dataset and experimental partitions is provided in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将 GMDB-Frequent 分为培训、验证和测试组, 我们只使用GMDB-Rare来评估,因为它提供了一套综合症-脱节测试,用于评估所学的原型是否从训练期间没有观察到的症状中将面部图像概括为面部图像. 这种评价环境反映了对极端罕见状况的临床诊断,其中潜在的失调症可能没有在培训数据中得到体现. 数据集和实验分区概况见表1。

blocks.en: Control datasets
blocks.zh: 控制数据集

blocks.en:
To evaluate the utility of the prototypes for distinguishing individuals with rare disorders from unaffected individuals (controls), we used two open facial-image datasets: CASIA-WebFace ( Yi et al. 2014 ) and UTKFace ( Zhang et al. 2017 ) . These datasets contain 494,414 and 23,708 images, respectively. UTKFace provides annotations for age, sex, and ethnicity. The GMDB dataset predominantly contains images of children (92.4% < 18 <18 years of age). In contrast, only 17.9% of the images in UTKFace depict individuals under 18. To account for this imbalance and further evaluate our method, we constructed a matched control cohort from UTKFace following the approach described by Pantel et al. ( Pantel et al. 2020 ) . Each test image from GMDB was matched with an image of an individual without a rare disorder based on age, sex, and ethnicity.
We cropped and aligned all images based on image-preprocessing method proposed in ( Hsieh et al. 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:

UTKFace提供年龄、性别和种族的说明。 GMDB数据集主要包含儿童图像(92.4%) < 18 < 18岁)。 相比之下,UTKFace中只有17.9%的图像描绘的是18岁以下的个人. 为了说明这种不平衡状况并进一步评价我们的方法,我们按照Pantel等人所述的方法,从UTKFace建立了一个匹配的控制组。 (Pantel等人,2020年). 来自GMDB的每个测试图像都与一个没有基于年龄、性别和种族的罕见障碍的个人图像匹配。

blocks.zh: 区域原型

blocks.en: A limitation of the global max pooling used in PIP-Net is that it ignores spatial location. A prototype can contribute to the prediction regardless of where its strongest activation occurs, and the maximizing location may change across images. This is problematic for facial phenotyping, where a prototype should represent a feature from a consistent anatomical region. For example, a prototype intended to capture a periorbital feature should only activate on that region.
blocks.zh: PIP-Net中使用的全球最大集合的限制在于它忽略了空间位置. 一个原型可以帮助预测,无论它最强的激活在哪里发生,而最大化的位置可能会在图像中发生改变. 这对面部麻痹有问题,在面部麻痹中,原型应该代表一个连贯解剖区域的特征. 例如,旨在捕捉近轨特征的原型只应在该区域激活。

blocks.en: Syndromic-versus-control classification performance

blocks.en: We evaluated five CNN backbones(ResNet50, ResNet101 ( He et al. 2016 ) , IResNet100 ( Deng et al. 2019 ) , ConvNeXt13, ConvNeXt26) to determine whether syndrome-identification performance and the effects of region masking were consistent across different feature extractors rather than specific to a single architecture. The number of prototypes ( P P ) are each backbone’s output channel count. Using the trained classification heads, IResNet100 achieved the strongest overall performance: region masking produced the highest Top-1 accuracy (33.56%), whereas global max pooling produced the highest Top-5 and Top-10 accuracies (52.27% and 59.86%). Region masking improved Top-1 accuracy for four of the five backbones, although its effect on higher-rank accuracy varied.

blocks.en: Case study: Prototype consistency in Cornelia de Lange syndrome
blocks.zh: 案例研究:Cornelia de Lange综合征中的原型一致性

blocks.en:
To assess the anatomical and clinical relevance of the learned prototypes, we selected
Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) as a case study and examined the consistency of the
prototypes driving its classification. The model (RM) correctly classified 30 of the 43 CdLS
test images, corresponding to a top-1 accuracy of 69.8%. For each image, we identified
the ten prototypes that contributed most strongly to the CdLS prediction. These
decision-driving prototypes were consistent across patients, with a mean pairwise
Jaccard similarity of 0.335, compared with a random-subset baseline of 0.007. The most
frequently recurring prototypes localized to the eyebrows, eyes, nose, and cheeks
(Table 5 ), which correspond to facial regions containing
features that are clinically relevant to the diagnosis of CdLS ( Rohatgi et al. 2010 ) .

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: ProtoGestalt addresses a clinically broader task than models optimized solely for syndrome classification: it supports both syndromic-versus-control screening and syndrome identification while providing anatomically localized, additive prototype-based explanations. To situate this second capability against prior work, we additionally evaluated the prototype representations under the retrieval protocol of Hustinx et al. (2022) , covering both syndromes seen during training (GMDB-Frequent) and ultra-rare syndromes absent from training (GMDB-Rare); full results are reported in Technical Supplement: Appendix A. ProtoGestalt did not match the syndrome-identification performance of specialized facial-phenotype embedding models, but its representations retained discriminative information for both seen and unseen syndromes while also separating syndromic images from controls. This trade-off may be valuable in front-line settings, where the initial clinical question is often whether a patient warrants genetic evaluation rather than which specific syndrome is present.
blocks.zh: ProtoGestalt处理的是临床上比仅为综合症分类而优化的模型范围更广的任务:它既支持合成与控制筛选,又支持综合症鉴定,同时提供解剖本地化,添加剂原型为基础的解释. 为了将第二种能力与先前的工作相配合,我们进一步评价了Hustinx等人(2022年)的检索协议下的原型表示,涵盖训练期间所见综合症(GMDB-Frequent)和没有参加训练的超罕见综合症(GMDB-Rare);技术补编:附录A中报告了全部结果。 ProtoGestalt与特殊面部-苯基嵌入模型的症状识别性能不符,但其表示保留了可见和看不见综合症的歧视性信息,同时也将合成图像与控制区分开来。 这种权衡在一线环境下可能很有价值,在一线环境中,最初的临床问题常常是病人是否需要基因评价,而不是是否存在具体的综合症.

blocks.en: Region masking improved anatomical consistency and interpretability but reduced recall or overall predictive performance in several experiments. This finding suggests that strict spatial constraints may exclude informative global facial cues or interactions among facial regions. A further limitation is that individuals in CASIA-WebFace and UTKFace were assumed not to have rare disorders because their clinical status was unavailable. These datasets may therefore include undiagnosed individuals, potentially biasing estimates of screening performance. We also trained a simple logistic regression (LR) model using region-masked (RM) prototype representations from equal subsets of CASIA-WebFace and UTKFace to predict the source dataset of each image. The model achieved an AUPRC of 0.8, suggesting the presence of detectable dataset-specific signals among the control images. Consequently, the use of unmatched or naively assembled control datasets may inflate apparent screening performance by allowing models to exploit domain differences rather than clinically meaningful phenotypic features. Finally, prototype consistency and clinical relevance were evaluated only for Cornelia de Lange syndrome because of the scope of this study, limiting the generalizability of these findings to other disorders. Future work should therefore include a comprehensive cross-syndrome evaluation of prototype consistency and clinical relevance. It should also investigate graph neural networks applied to landmark-based facial graphs to model relationships among anatomical regions, with the goal of improving prototype quality, consistency, and diagnostic performance.
blocks.zh: 区域掩盖提高了解剖的一致性和可解释性,但在若干实验中降低了召回性或总体预测性能。 这一调查结果表明,严格的空间限制可能排除信息丰富的全球面部暗示或面部区域之间的互动。 另一个限制是,CASIA-WebFace和UTKFace中的个人被认为没有罕见的疾病,因为他们的临床状态不存在. 因此,这些数据集可能包括未经诊断的个人,可能会对筛选业绩产生偏见。 我们还利用来自CASIA-WebFace和UTKFace的等子集的区块化(RM)原型表示法培训了一个简单的后勤回归模型,以预测每个图像的源数据集. 该模型实现了0.8的AUPRC,表明控制图像中存在可探测的数据集特定信号. 因此,使用不匹配或天真地组装的控制数据集可能会通过让模型利用域域差异而不是临床上有意义的线粒体特征来提高明显的筛选性能。 最后,原型一致性和临床相关性只针对Cornelia de Lange综合征进行了评价,因为本研究范围很广,这些发现的通用性仅限于其他障碍. 因此,今后的工作应包括对原型一致性和临床相关性进行全面的跨部门评价。 它还应调查适用于基于里程碑的面部图的图表神经网络,以模拟解剖区域之间的关系,目的是提高原型的质量、一致性和诊断性能。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: ProtoGestalt demonstrates that anatomically constrained prototypes can support interpretable facial phenotyping of rare genetic disorders. Its prototype-based representations also support identification of disorders while providing localized facial evidence that can be inspected alongside model outputs. Unlike methods that rely primarily on post-hoc explanations, ProtoGestalt provides intrinsic, anatomically grounded evidence for its predictions. This framework may therefore serve as a foundation for more transparent and clinically useful facial-phenotyping systems.
blocks.zh: ProtoGestalt表明,解剖受限的原型可以支持可解释的面部对稀有基因紊乱的phynotyp. 其基于原型的表示也支持识别失调,同时提供可与模型输出一起检查的局部面部证据. 与主要依靠后热解释的方法不同,ProtoGestalt为其预测提供了内在,解剖依据的证据. 因此,这一框架可作为更加透明和临床实用的面部围网系统的基础。
